answer:
Net sales are down heavily in the same partial week: last week’s top channels and products generated most revenue — this week to date those same channels and hero products are ~60–80% lower, concentrating the drop in Meta (IG/FB) and a few hero SKUs.

- By channel (net sales · orders)
  - Last week (2026-10-05–10-11): IG feed ₹295,587 · 161 orders; FB feed ₹61,291 · 33; Google PMax ₹66,220 · 36; Google Search ₹57,509 · 31; Exchange/Replacement ₹97,032 · 47.
  - This week so far (2026-10-12–10-14, partial): IG feed ₹63,605 · 30 orders (−78.5% vs last week); FB feed ₹12,625 · 10 (−79.4%); Google PMax ₹15,995 · 12 (−75.8%); Google Search ₹31,190 · 12 (−45.8%); Exchange/Replacement ₹38,625 · 23 (−60.2%).
- By product (product net revenue · orders)
  - Last week top sellers: Pawveralls Suspender Boots ₹96,783 · 53 orders; Meow Scratch Lounge ₹87,465 · 40; WingBird Smart Flapping Toy ₹48,107 · 48.
  - This week top sellers (partial): Play Scratch Lounge ₹18,553 · 8; Pawveralls Suspender Boots ₹16,731 · 9; Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots ₹15,037 · 7 — hero SKUs are producing far less revenue than last week (Pawveralls Suspender Boots: ₹96,783 → ₹16,731, −82.7%).
- What this means
  - The sales drop is concentrated where most revenue came from last week: IG/FB paid channels and a few hero SKUs — their combined shortfall explains the majority of the total drop reported earlier.
  - Google Search held up relatively better (smaller % decline), so organic / search demand is less affected than paid social.
  - Numbers for this week are partial (data through 15:00 IST on 2026-10-14); final week-over-week percentages may change as the week completes.
